-- By Logical

-- Efficiency based on your best pets.

local pets = {}
local looping = false -- set to true to loop until rejoin

-- DO NOT CHANGE ANYTHING HERE UNLESS I HAVE MARKED IT.
workspace.__THINGS.__REMOTES:FindFirstChild("unequip all pets"):InvokeServer({})
workspace.__THINGS.__REMOTES:FindFirstChild("equip best pets"):InvokeServer({})

wait(2)

for i,v in pairs(game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.Inventory.Frame.Main.Pets:GetChildren()) do
    if v:IsA("TextButton") then
        if v.Equipped.Visible then
            table.insert(pets, v.Name)
        end
    end
end

repeat
    for i,coin in pairs(workspace.__THINGS.Coins:GetChildren()) do
        if workspace.__THINGS.Coins:FindFirstChild(coin.Name) then
            if (game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position - coin:FindFirstChildOfClass("MeshPart").Position).magnitude <= 200 then -- to change the radius change this number next to '<='
                workspace.__THINGS.__REMOTES:FindFirstChild("join coin"):InvokeServer({coin.Name,pets})
                for i, fpet in pairs(pets) do
                    workspace.__THINGS.__REMOTES:FindFirstChild("change pet target"):FireServer({fpet,"Coin",coin.Name})
                    workspace.__THINGS.__REMOTES:FindFirstChild("farm coin"):FireServer({coin.Name,fpet})
                end
                repeat wait() until not workspace.__THINGS.Coins:FindFirstChild(coin.Name)
            end
        end
    end
    for i, orb in pairs(workspace.__THINGS.Orbs:GetChildren()) do
        local plrcf = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
        if workspace.__THINGS.Orbs:FindFirstChild(orb.Name) then
            repeat game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = orb.CFrame wait(1) until not workspace.__THINGS.Orbs:FindFirstChild(orb.Name)
        end
        game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = plrcf
    end
    for i, bag in pairs(workspace.__THINGS.Lootbags:GetChildren()) do
        local plrcf = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
        if workspace.__THINGS.Lootbags:FindFirstChild(bag.Name) then
            repeat game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = bag.CFrame wait(2) until not workspace.__THINGS.Lootbags:FindFirstChild(bag.Name)
        end
        game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = plrcf
    end
until not looping

local Golden_Eggs = {}
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Eggs = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Game").Eggs

if rconsolewarn then
rconsoleclear()
rprint = rconsolewarn
else
rprint = print
end

function Time(Tick) -- Not By me
if typeof(Tick) ~= "number" then
return warn('Integer expected, got', typeof(Tick))
end
local Tick = tick() - Tick
local Weeks = math.floor(math.floor(math.floor(math.floor(Tick / 60) / 60) / 24) / 7)
local Days =  math.floor(math.floor(math.floor(Tick / 60) / 60) / 24)
local Hours = math.floor(math.floor(Tick / 60) / 60)
local Minutes = math.floor(Tick / 60)
local Seconds = math.floor(Tick)
local MilliSeconds = (Tick * 1000)
local Format = ""
if Weeks > 0 then
Format = Format .. string.format("%d Week/s, ", Weeks)
end
if Days > 0 then
Format = Format .. string.format("%d Day/s, ", Days % 7)
end
if Hours > 0 then
Format = Format .. string.format("%d Hour/s, ", Hours % 24)
end
if Minutes > 0 then
Format = Format .. string.format("%d Minute/s, ", Minutes % 60)
end
if Seconds > 0 then
Format = Format .. string.format("%d Second/s, ", Seconds % 60)
end
if MilliSeconds > 0 then
Format = Format .. string.format("%d Ms", MilliSeconds % 1000)
end
return Format
end

local startTick = tick()

for _,eggFolder in pairs(Eggs:GetChildren()) do
for _,eggName in pairs(eggFolder:GetChildren()) do
if string.find(eggName.Name, "Golden") then
table.insert(Golden_Eggs, eggName.Name)
else
table.insert(Normal_Eggs, eggName.Name)
end
end
task.wait()
end

rprint("Added all eggs to database. Took "..tostring(Time(startTick)))


while _G.Enabled == true and wait(0.05) do
local args = {}

local goldenegg = Golden_Eggs[math.random(1, #Golden_Eggs)]
if useGolden == true then
if math.random(1,2) == 1 then
args = {normalegg, false}
rprint("[Mastery Farm] Buying: "..normalegg)
else
args = {goldenegg, false}
rprint("[Mastery Farm] Buying: "..goldenegg)
end
else
args = {normalegg, false}
rprint("[Mastery Farm] Buying: "..normalegg)
end
local e = event:InvokeServer(args)
repeat wait() until e ~= nil
rprint("Running Time: "..tostring(Time(startTick)))
end
